profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary: Accomplished software engineer with proven track record of delivering high quality code. Experienced in all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including customer requirements gathering, design, coding and benchmarking, testing, debugging, maintenance, and release. Strong team player, and avid learner. Zig enthusiast.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: Designed and built industry leading wireless spectrum analysis, visualization, and troubleshooting software for Windows, OS X, Android and Linux. Production code includes MetaGeek’s Chanalyzer, InSSIDer, and InSSIDer Office software. Built and maintained the company’s internal financial data analysis and visualization website.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded to try out some new ideas and technologies, Clockwork Engine was focused on making apps that would be both beautiful and functional.  The resulting software applications released were Spyglass for Windows and LightPaper for Android/OSX.

positions.title: Firmware/Software Engineer
positions.description: Created new functionality for, and maintained HP’s Multi-Function Printer ‘Image Pipe’, a modular set of data transforms for manipulating image data between the scanner and the print driver, designed to deliver best in class copy and scan quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of contract engineers in the development of emulation software for Hewlett Packard, including print engine emulators, formatter board emulators, and scanner emulators. These emulators were used in place of expensive prototype printer engines, to lessen development time and cost of new products.
